page_title: CRE 1-1 UDI | Cremonese v Udinese 20/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' Lennon Miller (Udinese) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
90+2' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) sends it out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' The ball is behind the sideline. Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) takes a throw-in.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Lennon Miller (Udinese) coming on for Arthur Atta.
86' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli is replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
84' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) is booked by the referee.
84' Adam Buksa (Udinese) commits a foul during an attacking move. Cremonese will take a free kick.
82' A raking crossfield pass from Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
80' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 13:11.
79' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) wins the ball from the free kick and fires in an amazing shot at goal which hits the left post! The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
78' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) violates the laws of the game and is shown a yellow card by the referee, but it could have been a straight red as well.
77' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
75' Here comes a substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo is given a rest as he is replaced by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
75' Here is a change. Federico Bonazzoli is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Franco Vazquez (Cremonese).
74' Jari Vandeputte goes off the pitch and Jeremy Sarmiento (Cremonese) comes on.

72' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Udinese, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
70' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Udinese have a free kick.
69' The foul by Oumar Solet (Udinese) was seen by Michael Fabbri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick is awarded to Cremonese.
69' The current number of shots on goal is 4:1.
68' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
67' Adam Buksa rounds off a good move with a layoff to Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
65' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
65' Maduka Okoye (Udinese) will take a goal kick to hopefully start an attacking move for his team.
62' That's the end of the game for Vakoun Issouf Bayo, who is replaced by Adam Buksa (Udinese).
62' A substitution has been made. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp is replaced by Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese).
62' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dachi Lordkipanidze (Cremonese) replacing Martin Payero.
61' Substitution. Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) in, Alessio Zerbin out.

61' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
60' Martin Payero (Cremonese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.

60' The opposition back off Jamie Vardy (Cremonese), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye denies him with the save. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
59' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is caught in the offside trap.
58' Martin Payero (Cremonese) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Free kick. Udinese will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
57' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) sends a long ball in, but Maduka Okoye comfortably gathers the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
57' The ball is out of play. Cremonese will have a throw-in.
55' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
55' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) and Giuseppe Pezzella matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
53' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a long ball forward to Jurgen Ekkelenkamp, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is behind the touchline and Cremonese will take a throw-in.
51' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header inside the right post.
50' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) and Martin Payero combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
49' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Udinese are awarded the free kick.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
46' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball has crossed the sideline. Cremonese are taking a throw-in.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is given a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Cremonese earn a free kick.
43' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle as Christian Kabasele (Udinese) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cremonese.
43' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

42' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
41' The referee blows his whistle as Warren Bondo (Cremonese) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick to Udinese.
39' Martin Payero (Cremonese) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Giuseppe Pezzella. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Udinese.
38' Arthur Atta (Udinese) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
36' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
35' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
34' Arthur Atta (Udinese) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
33' Shots on target – 2:0.
32' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
30' Saba Goglichidze (Udinese) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
28' The corner from Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye.
27' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes the corner but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Cremonese will take a corner.
26' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) and Jari Vandeputte combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
24' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move. It's a free kick to Udinese in a dangerous position.

22' Nicolo Zaniolo sprays a pass out to Arthur Atta (Udinese), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
21' Oumar Solet (Udinese) has proven his good peripheral vision as he picks out Hassane Kamara with a lovely through ball.
19' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) is penalised for a foul. Michael Fabbri had a clear view and blows his whistle. Cremonese are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
18' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Udinese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
15' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
13' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Alessandro Zanoli darts into free space to control the ball.
12' The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

9' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) attempts to find Giuseppe Pezzella with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is out of play. Cremonese will take a throw-in.
8' Saba Goglichidze (Udinese) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. It's a throw-in for Cremonese.
6' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
4' 1 - 0 The ball is whipped in from the free kick and finds Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese), who rises and produces an amazing header into the top of the net.
4' Cremonese get a free kick. Poor challenge! Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) is penalised for tripping and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle.
3' The corner from Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is hurriedly cleared.

2' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. Cremonese will take a free kick near the side line.
1' The linesman signals a throw-in for Udinese.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Cremonese will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Michael Fabbri.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
Show lineups
